status: DRAFT — UNSIGNED (automated execution; human review and signature outstanding)

body.anaDetail: No AI provider is configured. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (or OPENAI_API_KEY / KIMI_API_KEY) — without one, every AnA turn returns 503 GATEWAY_UNAVAILABLE.

steps.title: Anonymous access refused
steps.action: GET /api/mdx/qms/documents without Authorization

steps.title: Controlled document creation validates its inputs
steps.action: POST /api/mdx/qms/documents {docNumber, title} without docType
steps.expected: HTTP 422 with field errors

steps.title: Create an SOP; it is draft at version 1.0 and audited
steps.action: POST /api/mdx/qms/documents {docNumber, title, docType:"sop", nextReviewDate:+10d}; GET list; GET detail
steps.expected: HTTP 201; status draft, version 1.0; meta.auditTrail reports the §11.10(e) row; listed and readable

steps.title: Duplicate document number refused
steps.action: POST /api/mdx/qms/documents with the same docNumber
steps.expected: HTTP 409

steps.title: CREDENTIALED: a second identity approves SOP A as an electronic signature; the approval is stamped, audited and signed; a second approval is refused
steps.action: sign in as OQ_SIGNER_EMAIL with its password (and its authenticator code where the server requires MFA); when the signer has a second factor enrolled (OQ_SIGNER_TOTP_SECRET), first approve with {password} only; POST /api/mdx/qms/documents/:docA/approve {password, mfaToken?, meaning:"APPROVED", reason, effectiveDate}; approve again
steps.expected: A signer with a second factor enrolled: the password-only approval is refused 400 MFA_TOKEN_REQUIRED, SOP A stays in review and no signature row is written (§11.200). HTTP 200: status effective, approver_id = signer (≠ author), approved_at set, meta.auditTrail {persisted, chained}, meta.signature {id, meaning APPROVED, boundPayloadDigest (sha256), bindingBasis qms-document-version-content-sha256}; metadata.approval.contentDigest equals the signature digest; second approve → 409 QMS_INVALID_STATE. Without OQ_SIGNER_EMAIL / OQ_SIGNER_PASSWORD the step is recorded "not executed — credential not supplied".
steps.observed: password-only approval refused 400 MFA_TOKEN_REQUIRED with no row written; approved with password + TOTP; effective; author 1 (oq-runner@validation.local) ≠ approver 3 (oq-signer@validation.local) at 2026-09-28T01:35:00.691Z; signature 5 meaning APPROVED, password+totp, digest df799ac5cbdc…; auditTrail={"persisted":true,"chained":true}; re-approve → 409 QMS_INVALID_STATE
steps.note: VSR-001 §8.3 P-2 / F-3: approval is a signing act (§11.50, §11.200); the runner's dev-login session holds no password, so the signer is a tester-supplied identity (tests/validation/lib/credentials.mjs). The two-person rule (§11.10(d)) means the signer must not be the author of SOP A (the run identity).

steps.title: Exactly one electronic_signatures row is bound to the approval; the §11.70 content digest recomputes from the stored document
steps.action: GET /api/part11/signatures/by-target?target=qms-document:<docA>; GET /api/mdx/qms/documents/:docA; recompute sha256(canonicalJson(version content)) (tests/validation/lib/qms-digest.mjs — a re-implementation of computeQmsDocumentContentDigest)
steps.expected: One row: signer_id = signer, signature_meaning APPROVED, signature_type qms-document-approval, binding_basis qms-document-version-content-sha256, is_valid true, second_factor_verified true when the signer has a second factor enrolled; the recomputed digest equals meta.signature.boundPayloadDigest and metadata.approval.contentDigest
steps.observed: 1 row (id 5) by signer 3, APPROVED, qms-document-version-content-sha256, second_factor_verified true; recomputed digest df799ac5cbdc… == signature == document (match true)

steps.title: Create a second SOP (fixture for the credential refusals, training, review-due and retire steps)
steps.action: POST /api/mdx/qms/documents {docNumber SOP-OQ-B-…, docType:"sop", nextReviewDate:+5d}
steps.expected: HTTP 201, draft v1.0

steps.title: Approval without any signature component is refused
steps.action: POST /documents/:docB/approve {} (no password, no meaning, no reason)
steps.expected: HTTP 400 ESIGNATURE_COMPONENT_MISSING; fieldErrors name password, meaning and reason; docB stays draft
steps.observed: HTTP 400 ESIGNATURE_COMPONENT_MISSING (fieldErrors: password, meaning, reason); docB still draft

steps.title: CREDENTIALED: a wrong password is refused and nothing is signed
steps.action: as the signer, POST /documents/:docB/approve {password:<wrong>, meaning:"APPROVED", reason}
steps.expected: HTTP 401 PASSWORD_VERIFICATION_FAILED; docB stays draft; no signature row for docB
steps.observed: HTTP 401 PASSWORD_VERIFICATION_FAILED; docB still draft; 0 signature rows

steps.title: CREDENTIALED: the author cannot approve their own document (two-person rule)
steps.action: as the signer, POST /api/mdx/qms/documents (SOP C, authored by the signer); then approve it with the signer's own valid password
steps.expected: HTTP 403 QMS_SELF_APPROVAL; SOP C stays draft; no signature row
steps.observed: SOP C 11 authored by 3; self-approve → HTTP 403 QMS_SELF_APPROVAL; still draft; 0 signature rows

steps.title: CREDENTIALED: the signer approves SOP B (fixture — an effective document for the review-due and retire steps)
steps.action: as the signer, POST /documents/:docB/approve {password, meaning:"APPROVED", reason}
steps.expected: HTTP 200 effective with meta.signature; one signature row for docB

steps.title: Open a controlled revision (reason required; major version bump; back to draft)
steps.action: POST /revise {} then POST /revise {reason}
steps.expected: Without reason → 422; with reason → version 2.0, status draft, prior approval cleared, audited

steps.title: Training acknowledgement is recorded against the document version
steps.action: POST /documents/:id/training-ack {method:"attestation"}; GET /api/mdx/qms/training/compliance
steps.expected: HTTP 201 with document_version; compliance report HTTP 200
steps.observed: ack for v1.0; compliance: {"data":[{"id":10,"doc_number":"SOP-OQ-B-20260928013450","title":"OQ-006 Second SOP 20260928013450","current":1,"of":5,"last_cycle":"2026-09-28T01:36:31.830Z"}]

steps.title: Review-due report lists effective documents approaching review
steps.action: GET /api/mdx/qms/documents/review-due?within=30 (docB is effective with nextReviewDate +5d)
steps.expected: docB listed with overdue=false

steps.title: A reason alone does not retire a controlled document
steps.action: as the run identity (an editor), POST /documents/:docB/retire {reason} with no password and no meaning
steps.expected: HTTP 400 ESIGNATURE_COMPONENT_MISSING; fieldErrors name password and meaning; docB keeps the status it had; no new signature row
steps.observed: HTTP 400 ESIGNATURE_COMPONENT_MISSING (fieldErrors: password, meaning); docB still effective; signature rows unchanged (1)
steps.note: Security review 2026-09-24, DP-32 / P1-29: until 2026-09-26 this request retired the document (OQ-QMS-10 as executed on 2026-09-23c is the record of that). Retirement is now the same electronic signature as approval (§11.50, §11.200); this step runs with or without the signer credential, so the refusal is observed on every execution.

steps.title: CREDENTIALED: the signer retires SOP B as an electronic signature; the retirement is stamped, audited and signed; a second retirement is refused
steps.action: as the signer, POST /documents/:docB/retire {password, mfaToken?, meaning:"APPROVED", reason}; read the signatures by target; recompute the §11.70 digest from the stored row; retire again
steps.expected: HTTP 200: status retired, metadata.retired {reason, meaning APPROVED, contentDigest, bindingBasis, by = signer, at, fromStatus effective}, meta.auditTrail {persisted, chained}, meta.signature {id, meaning APPROVED, boundPayloadDigest (sha256), bindingBasis qms-document-version-content-sha256}; metadata.retired.contentDigest equals the signature digest; the signatures for docB are now two, the new one signature_type qms-document-retirement by the signer; the digest recomputed from the stored row (version content minus metadata.approval and metadata.retired) equals the signature digest; second retire → 409 QMS_INVALID_STATE
steps.observed: retired by 3 (oq-signer@validation.local) from effective at 2026-09-28T01:37:00.721+00:00; signature 7 meaning APPROVED, password+totp, digest b69661ec5a25… (recomputed match true); 2 rows for docB; auditTrail={"persisted":true,"chained":true}; re-retire → 409 QMS_INVALID_STATE
steps.note: Security review 2026-09-24, DP-32 / P1-29. Retiring is the terminal transition of an effective procedure and a signed record (§11.50, §11.200), taken with the same ceremony as the approval: signing authority, password and enrolled second factor re-verified, the meaning, one electronic_signatures row bound to the version content, the UPDATE and the chained audit row in one transaction (server/services/qms/document-approval-signature.ts retireQmsDocumentSigned).

steps.title: Change control: raise and list a change
steps.action: POST /api/mdx/qms/changes {changeNumber, title, reason}; GET /api/mdx/qms/changes; GET /changes/summary
steps.expected: HTTP 201 and the change is listed

steps.title: Quality Management Plan create and list (governed: reason required)
steps.action: POST /api/quality/plans {name, description} with no reason; again with a reason of at least 8 characters; GET /api/quality/plans
steps.expected: Without a reason: HTTP 400 REASON_REQUIRED and no plan created. With it: HTTP 201; plan listed with status draft

steps.title: Quality-system templates are served
steps.action: GET /api/mdx/qms/templates
steps.expected: HTTP 200 with a non-empty template family

steps.title: Quality surface renders the SOP register and the Change control tab
steps.action: Open /concept2cure/quality; find the SOP number; click the "Change control" tab
steps.expected: SOP register shows the created SOP; Change control tab renders (an unavailable store is an honest error state)
steps.observed: SOP register shows the SOP; change control tab captured

steps.action: Open /concept2cure/qmp
steps.expected: The plan name is visible
